obligations.summary: Before placing on the market or putting into service a high-risk AI system listed in Annex III (except point 2), the provider or authorised representative must register themselves and their system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.
exceptions: High-risk AI systems referred to in point 2 of Annex III are excluded from this registration requirement.

obligations.summary: Before placing on the market or putting into service an AI system concluded by the provider to be not high-risk under Article 6(3), the provider or authorised representative must register themselves and that system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.

Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system listed in Annex III (except point 2), deployers that are public authorities, Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, or persons acting on their behalf must register themselves, select the system, and register its use in the EU database referred to in Article 71.
exceptions: High-risk AI systems referred to in point 2 of Annex III are excluded from this registration requirement.

obligations.summary: For high-risk AI systems in law enforcement, migration, asylum and border control management (Annex III points 1, 6 and 7), registration must be conducted in a secure non-public section of the EU database and must include only the information specified in Annex VIII sections A, B and C and Annex IX as enumerated, with access limited to the Commission and national authorities referred to in Article 74(8).
exceptions: Only the Commission and national authorities referred to in Article 74(8) shall have access to the restricted sections of the EU database for these systems.

obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems referred to in point 2 of Annex III must be registered at national level rather than in the EU database.
